evidence: Historical 28,000-second Kaggle monolithic run lacked guaranteed intermediate outputs. Future independently approved Kaggle sAlex full driver now accepts optional --partial-output-dir, wired to /kaggle/working/rhombus_salex_partial_chunks. A new optional on_committed_batch callback runs only after SQLite membership batch COMMIT; each 50,000 committed records from source-bound sAlex streaming are exported as a separate full gzip JSONL with SHA256 and append-only JSON receipt; machine-readable progress is flushed after each sealed chunk. Crash leaves an untrusted .inflight file but retains earlier completed chunk/receipt pairs if the Kaggle notebook version retains /working outputs. Offline no-network tests cover interrupted records, integrity tampering, claim-promotion rejection and output-directory reuse.
limitations: Files in /kaggle/working are not remotely guaranteed available while a kernel is running; a killed/failed Kaggle version may not preserve even fully written local chunks.

Partial records and source identifiers are diagnostic only. Original complete source SHA256, row count, MACE-MPA-0 training selection, overlap completeness and scientific generalization are NOT certified by pieces.
No restart-from-checkpoint, bounded separate Kaggle run versions or independently uploaded external artifacts are implemented. Without those, durable lossless crash recovery cannot be promised.
Existing pinned sAlex Kaggle kernel commit remains unchanged; no Kaggle job/remote transfer or automatic restart was triggered.
